item.title: Version 0.19.9
item.description:
SupaSidebar 0.19.9

What’s New

  • Duplicate Folder: Right-click any folder to duplicate it, including all its links and nested subfolders, in one step.
  • Move Tab to Another Browser: Right-click a live tab and choose “Move to Browser” to reopen it elsewhere and close the original.

Improvements

  • Clearer Tooltip Settings: Tooltips and previews now use a simple on/off switch with a delay dropdown, and “None” is renamed “Instant”.
  • Refined French Translations: French settings labels read more consistently, and the remaining English labels are now translated.

Bug Fixes

  • The space header now counts every saved link in the space, instead of counting each folder as one.
  • You can now switch spaces using the physical thumb wheel on an MX Master mouse.
  • Expanding a folder in a large library no longer freezes the app while icons load.
  • A live tab row now shows the correct icon after a tab closes, instead of keeping the previous tab’s favicon.
